description: This file defines the class BaseContainerIterator, which implements an iterator over a collection of container IDs, providing methods to navigate and access the IDs within the collection.

classes.name: BaseContainerIterator
classes.description: A class that provides iteration capabilities over a list of container IDs, supporting navigation, validation, and retrieval of current ID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next ID in the collection, returning true if the new position is valid.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous ID in the collection, returning true if the new position is valid.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to an initial invalid position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current position of the iterator points to a valid ID.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of IDs in the collection.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the current ID the iterator points to.
